top_jobs.job: When a shopper taps our ad on a phone on a slow connection and waits, help me get the product, price and buy button on screen in under 2.5 seconds on the pages that sell, so I stop paying for clicks that leave before they see what they came for
top_jobs.metric: share of mobile visits with the main image and price painted in under 2.5 seconds (field LCP p75) on the top 10 paid landing pages, 28 days

top_jobs.job: When apps, scripts and old code pile up on the pages, help me cut what earns nothing and put a dollar figure on what stays, so I pay for speed only where it makes money
top_jobs.metric: script weight and main thread blocking time on product pages, and what slowness costs per month in our own dollars

top_jobs.job: When anyone ships a speed fix or a site change, help me test it on a copy of the theme, check tracking and the buying flow, and merge only if it wins, so I never lose sales to a speed fix
top_jobs.metric: speed changes with a measured before and after and no break after publish, share

top_jobs.job: When I pay a developer or an agency for speed, help me brief only the fixes that change what shoppers see on the pages that sell, so I pay for results, not scores
top_jobs.metric: dollars spent on speed per second saved on money pages, field data

jobs.job: Measure real mobile load for home, 2 collections, the top 5 product pages, the top ad landing pages, cart and checkout, from field data and a mid-range phone on 4G, and save a dated baseline with filmstrips
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then the 1st of each month

inputs.need: field data per page: main image paint (LCP), tap response (INP), layout shift (CLS), 28 days
inputs.from: PageSpeed Insights and Chrome field data API

inputs.need: pages ranked by paid and organic sessions
top ad landing URLs
a lab tool with a mid-range Android profile on 4G

steps: Pick the pages by sessions and by ad spend, not by what is easy
Pull 28 day field data for each, on mobile
Run 3 lab runs per page on a mid-range phone profile and keep the middle one
Save the filmstrip: what the shopper sees at 1, 2, 3 and 5 seconds
Write the baseline table with the date and the element that paints last
jobs.output: a dated baseline table per page with field and lab numbers and a filmstrip each
jobs.next: feeds 08-08 (revenue model), 08-17 (rank fixes) and every before and after in 08-14

watch.metric: pages with a dated baseline, share of pages that get paid traffic

jobs.drives: decisions on speed made from our numbers

jobs.job: Open the top 5 ad landing pages inside the Instagram and Facebook in-app browser on a mid-range phone, film the load, and compare it with Chrome and Safari
jobs.trigger: once, then after each theme change

inputs.need: top 5 ads by spend with their URLs
share of sessions from in-app browsers
a mid-range Android and an iPhone

steps: Send each ad preview to both phones and tap through inside the app
Screen record the load and note seconds to image, price and buy button
Repeat in Chrome and Safari for the same page
List what loads slower in the app: fonts, video, pop-ups, scripts that block
Hand the top gap to 08-03 as the first fix
jobs.output: a side by side of in-app vs browser load for 5 pages, with the worst gap named

watch.metric: seconds to price on screen in the Instagram in-app browser

jobs.drives: conversion rate from Meta clicks

jobs.job: Make the product image, price and buy button the first things to paint on mobile product pages: preload the main image at phone size, stop lazy loading it, and show text while fonts load
jobs.trigger: once per template, then on each theme change

inputs.need: the element that paints last per product template
theme code and a theme copy
speed fix steps

steps: Find the main image on the product template and preload it at phone width
Remove lazy loading from the first image only
Set fonts to show fallback text at once
Test on the theme copy: same 3 lab runs, same phone profile
Merge if the image and price paint sooner and nothing else broke
jobs.output: a product template that paints image and price first, with the before and after

watch.metric: field LCP p75 on product pages, mobile

jobs.drives: conversion rate from paid mobile sessions

jobs.job: Stop the page jumping: reserve space for review stars, banners, the sticky cart and app blocks, and measure layout shift before and after
jobs.trigger: once per template

inputs.need: layout shift per page and the element that moves
theme code and a theme copy
recordings with misclicks near moving blocks

steps: List the blocks that load late and push content down
Set a fixed height for each on the theme copy
Run the same tests on both themes
Watch 10 recordings for misclicks after the change
Merge if layout shift drops under 0.1 and nothing broke
jobs.output: templates with no visible jump, and layout shift under 0.1 on product pages

watch.metric: field CLS p75 on product pages, mobile

jobs.drives: add to cart rate

jobs.job: Resize and compress every product and banner image over 300 KB, and set a rule that blocks new uploads over that size without making the product look worse
jobs.trigger: once as a sweep, then on every upload

inputs.need: every image with its file size and where it shows
photo rules and approved product shots
an image compression app or CDN setting

steps: List images over 300 KB by page views
Resize to the largest size shown and compress, keeping the original
Compare 5 products side by side on a phone with the founder
Turn on compression for new uploads, including banners and blog images
Check the list monthly for new heavy images
jobs.output: a catalog with no image over 300 KB on money pages, and a rule for new uploads

watch.metric: total image weight on the top 10 pages

jobs.drives: field LCP on product and collection pages

jobs.job: Make add to cart, the size picker and the cart drawer answer a tap in under 200 milliseconds on a mid-range phone, by finding the scripts that block the tap
jobs.trigger: once, then after any app that touches the product form or cart

inputs.need: field tap response (INP) per page
inputs.from: PageSpeed Insights and Chrome field data API

inputs.need: a performance trace of tapping size and add to cart
inputs.from: Chrome DevTools on a phone profile

inputs.need: apps that hook into the product form or cart

steps: Record a trace of picking a size and tapping add to cart
List the scripts that run on the tap and how long each takes
Delay or remove the ones that are not needed for the tap, on a theme copy
Retest the tap and walk the buying flow
Merge if the tap answers in under 200 milliseconds and cart still works
jobs.output: a product form and cart that respond at once, with the scripts that blocked them named

watch.metric: field INP p75 on product pages, mobile

jobs.drives: add to cart rate, mobile

jobs.job: List every script that loads on product pages, the app or tag it belongs to, its size and blocking time, and whether that app is still installed and used
jobs.trigger: once, then each quarter

inputs.need: scripts per page with size and blocking time
installed apps and billing history
theme code with app snippets
which apps the team uses

steps: Record every script request on the product page
Match each to an app, a tag or the theme
Mark scripts from apps no longer installed as leftovers
Rank by blocking time
Hand leftovers to 08-09 and unused apps to 06-10
jobs.output: a script table: owner, size, blocking time, still used or leftover

watch.metric: third party script weight on product pages

jobs.drives: field LCP and INP on product pages

jobs.job: Build our own speed revenue model: conversion rate by load time from our sessions, then what 1 second faster on money pages is worth per month in dollars
jobs.trigger: once, then each quarter

inputs.need: sessions with a load time event and orders
inputs.from: GA4 with a load time event

inputs.need: sessions per page type, paid and organic
average order value and margin

steps: Add a load time event to GA4 if missing and wait 14 days
Bucket sessions by load time and compute conversion per bucket, in code
Fit the drop in conversion per extra second
Multiply by sessions per page type and gross profit per order
Write the dollar figure per second per page type, with the range
jobs.output: a table: dollars per month per second saved, by page type, from our own data
jobs.next: feeds 08-17 (rank fixes), 06-12 (dollars per app) and 08-11 (cost of a new app)

watch.metric: model built with 14 days of our own data

jobs.drives: speed budget spent where it pays

jobs.job: Remove leftover code from uninstalled apps and last season's banners, countdowns and gift apps on a theme copy, and log the seconds and dollars saved
jobs.trigger: after each app removal, and after every peak season

inputs.need: leftover scripts and snippets
seasonal apps and banners still live
dollars per second by page type

steps: List leftovers and seasonal extras still loading
Remove them on a theme copy
Run the same speed tests on both themes and walk the buying flow
Publish if it passes
Log seconds saved and dollars per month from the model
jobs.output: a lighter theme and a line in the log: 'removed 4 dead apps, 0.6 seconds, about $1,900 a month'

watch.metric: mobile load time on product pages

jobs.drives: conversion rate on product pages

jobs.job: Delay chat, pop-up, reviews carousel and non-purchase tags until the shopper scrolls or taps, and keep any that sell after a with and without test
jobs.trigger: once, then when a widget is added

inputs.need: widgets and tags on product pages
orders or leads each widget brings
theme copy

steps: List widgets that load before the product: chat, pop-up, reviews carousel, tags
Set each to load on first scroll or tap on the theme copy
For widgets that claim sales, like reviews, run a with and without test
Keep the widget if its sales beat the speed cost from the model
Merge and log
jobs.output: a product page where the product loads first, and a keep or cut call on each widget with its numbers

watch.metric: main thread blocking time on product pages

jobs.drives: field LCP and INP on product pages

jobs.job: Before any new app, page-builder page or autoplay video goes live, test its speed cost on a theme copy and show the founder the dollars at stake
jobs.trigger: before each new app, page-builder page or hero video

inputs.need: the app, page or video to add
theme copy
dollars per second by page type

steps: Add it to a theme copy only
Run the same tests on both themes
Convert the added seconds to dollars per month
Show the founder: what it adds, what it costs, a lighter option
Log the go or no-go decision
jobs.output: a go or no-go with the speed cost in dollars, before anything reaches the live theme

watch.metric: new apps or pages added without a speed test, count

jobs.drives: mobile load time on money pages

jobs.job: Duplicate the live theme, apply one speed change to the copy, run the same speed tests on both themes 3 times, walk the buying flow on the copy, and merge only if the copy wins on both
jobs.trigger: for every speed change

inputs.need: theme access and the duplicate theme feature
the same page list and lab settings as the baseline
a buying flow checklist: product, size, add to cart, cart, discount, checkout

steps: Duplicate the live theme and name it with the date and change
Make one change on the copy
Run 3 lab runs on each theme for each page, same phone and network
Walk the buying flow on the copy on 2 phones
Merge only if the copy is faster and the flow passes; keep the old theme for 14 days
jobs.output: a merged change with a side by side table, or a rejected change with the reason

watch.metric: speed changes that broke cart, reviews or size picker after publish, count

jobs.drives: days lost to a speed fix gone wrong

jobs.job: After every speed change, check the Meta pixel, Conversions API and GA4 still record add to cart and purchase, with a test order and 3 days of counts against store orders
jobs.trigger: after every speed or script change

inputs.need: purchases and add to carts by day
orders by day
the change and its date

steps: Place a test order on the live theme right after the merge
Check the test order shows in Meta and GA4 within 1 hour
For 3 days, compare Meta and GA4 purchases with store orders
Flag a gap over 10 percent and roll back the script change if it caused it
Log the date tracking was confirmed
jobs.output: a pass or fail on tracking for each change, with a date
jobs.next: failures go to 22-measurement and back to 08-12 for rollback

watch.metric: GA4 and Meta purchases as a share of store orders

jobs.drives: cost per purchase that Meta optimises on

jobs.job: Log every speed change with a same-day lab before and after and a 28 day field read, mark it kept, reverted or no effect, and promote what worked to the speed standard (T0)
jobs.trigger: at each merge, then 28 days later

inputs.need: baseline and after runs
field data 28 days after
inputs.from: PageSpeed Insights and Chrome field data API

inputs.need: conversion by page type before and after

steps: Write the change, the page type and the lab before and after on merge day
At 28 days, pull field data and conversion for the page type
Mark kept, reverted or no effect
Promote a kept fix to the speed standard every new page must meet
Write a fail note for fixes that moved the score but not real shoppers
jobs.output: a speed log with before, after and a verdict per change, and a speed standard list

watch.metric: fixes with a field read at 28 days, share

jobs.drives: dollars spent on fixes that did nothing

jobs.job: Set a speed budget per page type (image weight, script weight, main image paint time) and check every theme or app change against it the same day
jobs.trigger: once to set, then on every logged change

inputs.need: baseline per page type
store changes with date and owner
the speed standard list

steps: Set the budget per page type from the baseline and the standard
On each change, run the lab test on the affected page types
Flag any change that breaks the budget, with the owner
Owner fixes or rolls back within 2 days
Report budget breaks monthly
jobs.output: a budget per page type and a same-day flag on any change that breaks it

watch.metric: changes that broke the speed budget, count

jobs.drives: field LCP on money pages

jobs.job: Two weeks before a peak or big drop, load test the top pages at 10 times normal traffic, turn off nonessential apps for the day, and have the host plan and rollback ready
jobs.trigger: 2 weeks before each peak or drop

inputs.need: peak dates
normal and last peak's sessions per hour
a load test tool
host or platform plan limits

steps: Take last peak's busiest hour and multiply by 3 to 10 for the target
Load test the home, top product and cart pages on a theme copy
List apps to switch off for the day and switch them off on the copy
Confirm the plan limits and who to call at the host
Publish the peak theme 2 days before and keep the normal one ready
jobs.output: a peak theme tested at target traffic, and a named rollback

watch.metric: server response time and mobile load in the peak hour

jobs.drives: peak revenue against plan

jobs.job: Rank speed fixes by money: sessions on the page type times seconds the fix saves times dollars per second, and hand the top 3 to the developer
jobs.trigger: on the 1st of each month

inputs.need: candidate fixes with estimated seconds saved
dollars per second by page type
developer hours available

steps: List fixes from the baseline, the script table and the idea bank
Estimate seconds saved per fix on its page type
Compute dollars per month per fix, in code
Divide by developer hours to get dollars per hour of work
Pick the top 3 that fit the hours
jobs.output: a ranked fix list with dollars per month and per hour of work

watch.metric: dollars saved per developer hour, estimated

jobs.drives: field LCP on the pages that sell

jobs.job: Write each developer brief with the page, the change, the target number on a mid-range phone, the test that proves it, the tracking check and the way back
jobs.trigger: for each fix in the top 3

inputs.need: the fix and its page type
baseline numbers and filmstrip
who the developer is and their rate

steps: Name the page, the element and the change in plain words
Set the target: for example, main image painted by 2.5 seconds on a Moto G profile
Say the test: 3 lab runs on both themes, then 28 days of field data
Say the checks: buying flow and tracking (08-13)
Say the way back: the theme copy stays for 14 days
jobs.output: a 1 page brief per fix that pays for a result, not for hours

watch.metric: briefed fixes that hit their target, share

jobs.drives: dollars spent per second saved

jobs.job: Review an agency speed quote line by line and mark each fix as changes what shoppers see, score only, or skip, using our field data and page types
jobs.trigger: when a speed quote arrives

inputs.need: the agency quote with each fix and price
field and lab data per page type
pages that already pass

steps: List each quoted fix with its price
Check which page type it touches and whether that page already passes in field data
Mark changes what shoppers see, score only, or skip
Price the kept fixes against dollars per second
Send the agency the trimmed scope with the target numbers
jobs.output: a trimmed quote with each line marked and the dollars saved

watch.metric: quoted dollars cut from fixes that would not move field data

jobs.drives: dollars spent per second saved

jobs.job: Decide whether to keep patching the old theme or move to a lighter one: count patch hours in the last year, load our top product on the lighter theme's demo, and compare
jobs.trigger: once a year, or when patch hours pass 40 in a year

inputs.need: speed work and developer hours over 12 months
baseline per page type
a candidate theme to try on a copy

steps: Total patch hours and cost for speed in the last 12 months
Install the lighter theme as an unpublished copy with our top product and 1 collection
Run the same tests on both
List what the move would cost: build hours, apps to rewire, risk
Write keep or move with the numbers for the founder
jobs.output: a keep or move call with patch cost, speed gap and move cost side by side
jobs.next: a move goes to 06-08 and 08-12 for a staged switch

watch.metric: mobile load on the top product page, current vs lighter theme

jobs.drives: speed spend per year

new_enablers.name: Speed lab
new_enablers.what: Measures speed the way a shopper feels it: field data (Chrome user data, 28 days) per page type plus 3 lab runs on a mid-range phone on 4G, a filmstrip of what shows when, the Instagram and Facebook in-app browser, and a dated log of every change with its before and after. Holds the speed budget per page type.
inputs: PageSpeed Insights and Chrome field data API (free)
a lab tool with a mid-range phone profile
page list with paid and organic sessions
powers: an honest baseline in a day
before and after proof for every fix
a speed budget each change is checked against
the fix list ranked by money

new_enablers.name: Tracking event check
new_enablers.what: After any speed or theme change, places a test order and compares add to cart and purchase counts in the Meta pixel, the Conversions API and GA4 with store orders for 3 days. Flags a gap over 10 percent the day it starts.
powers: ads keep learning from true purchases after a speed fix
a date for when tracking broke
